## Description

Tiles with protocol, status (Healthy/Degraded/Not connected), last message, 24 h volume, direction; residency banner per deployment; record-authority switch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Tile status reflects real health checks and message flow.
- [ ] **AC2.** Secrets for connections live in Key Vault; rotation is audited.

## Definition of Done
